name: Rock cliff outside corner
description: The outside corner of the mossy grey cliff, a 1.5 × 1.5 m block about 3.5 m high: the rock face runs along -y, turns round a broken, rounded corner and runs on along +x, leaning back as it rises, with ledges, small overhangs and dark cracks, moss on the ledges, damp at the foot, a grassy top and ivy hanging over the edge. It joins a straight cliff section on -x and a straight section turned to face +x on +y.

provenance.prompt: The outside corner of cliff_rock_straight (a mossy grey rock face 1.5 m long, about 3.5 m high and 1.5 m deep, ledges and cracks, ivy at the top): a 1.5 × 1.5 m block whose face runs along -y and turns round the corner to +x, joining a straight section on -x and a straight section turned 90 degrees on +y.
